name: Hekara
description: Hekara is a bell-haired Rakdos emissary, Rat's best friend and role model, who dies and is resurrected as a blood witch.

status.text: As of the latest story Hekara is alive as a resurrected blood witch who no longer remembers or sees Rat, and Rakdos carries her off.

citations.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: In the War of the Spark, Rakdos refuses to cooperate because Hekara was killed.
timeline.quote: Rakdos initially was not cooperating at all with the anti-Bolas efforts because Hekara , his emissary, was killed.

citation.text: "Cult of Rakdos", section "Guilds of Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tomik brings back Hekara's corpse and she is revived as a bloodwitch; she beats Exava in a fight and agrees to help Kaya's group.
timeline.quote: Exava tried to object but lost to Hekara in a fight.

citation.text: "Cult of Rakdos", section "Guilds of Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Possessed Lavinia kills Hekara before Ral Zarek frees her.
timeline.quote: This led to Hekara being killed by Lavinia

citation.text: "Lavinia", section "Rebel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tomik Vrona delivers Hekara's corpse to the Jester's Crypt where she is resurrected as a blood witch.
timeline.quote: where she was resurrected into a blood witch

citation.text: "Rix Maadi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the war Teyo returns alone looking for Rat, fights Whipsaw and speaks with Hekara, leaving empty-handed.
timeline.quote: After the war, Teyo returned alone, looking for Rat.

citation.text: "Rix Maadi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska leads Golgari forces into Orzhova as a distraction so Kaya can kill the Obzedat.
timeline.quote: she led an army of rot zombies, trolls, and giant insects into Orzhova as a distraction

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Guildmaster". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska's betrayal leads to Hekara's death at the hands of a possessed Lavinia.
timeline.quote: Vraska's betrayal led to the Rakdos emissary Hekara being killed by a Bolas-possessed Lavinia

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Guildmaster". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya kills the Ghost Council and becomes guildmaster through a loophole.
timeline.quote: she had become the new guildmaster of the Syndicate

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Rix Maadi, Tomik brings Hekara's corpse, the cultists resurrect her as a blood witch, and she defeats Exava and leads the Rakdos against Bolas.
timeline.quote: the Rakdos cultists resurrected Hekara as a blood witch

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Rakdos resurrect Hekara as a blood witch.
timeline.quote: the Rakdos cultists resurrected Hekara as a blood witch

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hekara is revived as a bloodwitch and goes to help Kaya's group; Rakdos does not stop her.
timeline.quote: Hekara's corpse was brought back by Tomik and she was revived as a bloodwitch.

citation.text: "Rakdos (character)", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dovin Baan sabotages Ral's great machine, and Ral activates the Interplanar Beacon after defeating Vraska at the cost of Hekara's life.
timeline.quote: At the cost of Hekara's life, Ral was able to defeat Vraska and free Lavinia.

citation.text: "Ral Zarek", section "Changing the Implicit Maze". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tomik reunites with Ral and Hekara is resurrected as a blood witch to lead the Rakdos against Bolas.
timeline.quote: the Rakdos cultists resurrected Hekara as a blood witch

citation.text: "Ral Zarek", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hekara is resurrected as a blood witch and leads the Rakdos against Bolas.
timeline.quote: the Rakdos cultists resurrected Hekara as a blood witch

citation.text: "Teyo Verada", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ral, Kaya and Vraska conspire against Bolas, planning to make Niv-Mizzet the new Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: Ral, Kaya, and Vraska conspire against Bolas, realizing the dragon's treacherous nature.

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Prelude". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet fights Bolas without the Guildpact and is killed, Hekara is murdered, and Vraska flees to Ixalan.
timeline.quote: Niv-Mizzet attempts to fight Bolas without the power of the Guildpact , and ends up getting killed.

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Prelude". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya's team wins over the neutral guilds, with Vraska returned and Hekara resurrected, and Lavinia brings the Azorius on board.
timeline.quote: With some help from a returned Vraska and a resurrected Hekara, they succeed.

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 2". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rat meets her friend Hekara on the Transguild Promenade and reports on tailing Ral Zarek to Nivix, where he and Niv-Mizzet had an exploding experiment.
timeline.quote: Something about a beacon being their only chance now.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Hekara receives Zarek's summons to activate the beacon and tells Rat to take the night off.
timeline.quote: It's now-or-never time.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Hekara leaves, calling Rat by her full name, and Rat wanders the city until dawn when Hekara does not show.
timeline.quote: She wasn't there. I waited, but she didn't come.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Kaya tells Rat that Hekara is dead, devastating Rat.
timeline.quote: Hekara's dead,

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat fetches her mother Ari Shokta and tells her Hekara is dead.
timeline.quote: But Ari . . . Hekara's dead.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat dreads entering Rix Maadi without Hekara.
timeline.quote: I dreaded going down there, into Rix Maadi.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Tomik Vrona arrives with an Orzhov thrull carrying Hekara's corpse and returns her to her people.
timeline.quote: I have brought Hekara back to her people.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Exava and six blood witches dress Hekara's body in rags and bells and send it with the thrull into the Jester's Crypt, where the thrull is killed.
timeline.quote: Have your thrull take Hekara into the Jester's Crypt.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Exava blames Hekara's death on the betrayal, denial and failure of Vraska, Zarek and Kaya.
timeline.quote: One of you betrayed her, one of you denied her, and one of you simply failed her.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Hekara emerges from the Jester's Crypt alive, resurrected as a blood witch.
timeline.quote: What's your hurry, partners?

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Vraska apologizes to Hekara for betraying her trust.
timeline.quote: I owe you an apology, Hekara. I never should have betrayed your trust.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Hekara declares she will represent the Cult and fights Exava with razors, with Zarek shocking Exava from behind.
timeline.quote: Master Zarek fired up his Accumulator and fired off a relatively small bolt that caught Exava from behind.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Hekara calms the hellhound Whipsaw and walks past Rat without noticing her, revealing that her resurrection has left her unable to see Rat.
timeline.quote: She walked right past me—without noticing me at all.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Zarek reveals the plan is to resurrect the Firemind as the new Living Guildpact, surprising several guild leaders.
timeline.quote: We are here to resurrect the Firemind as the new Living Guildpact.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Hekara admits she came without Rakdos's permission, and the leaders doubt the plan without him.
timeline.quote: The Boss didn't send me in his place. I totally came without his permission.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Nissa leads the ritual; leylines light under the ten guild representatives and they fall into a trance with golden light pouring from their eyes.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, golden light poured out of twenty-one sightless eyes.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat protects Teyo, Kaya and Hekara during the fight.
timeline.quote: So I focused on protecting those three.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Rakdos appears as a giant flaming demon with Gideon riding his head, charging Bolas.
timeline.quote: And then I spotted Mister Jura, riding atop the demon's head.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Hekara performs with puppets and cannot remember what Rat looks like; Rakdos carries her off.
timeline.quote: I can't quite remember what Rat looks like.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

relations.quote: she was my best mate, my hero, my role model.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

relations.note: Exava tries to kill the revived Hekara.
relations.quote: Witch, I'll kill you all over again!
